title.en: China Unicom AS4837 vs AS9929 Global Routes: Low-Latency APAC Node Selection for Northern Users

cluster.zh: 三网运营商专属线路选型集群

description.zh: 全面对比中国联通普通骨干网 AS4837（169 网）与精品网 AS9929（联通 A 网）在北方各省的国际出口路由表现，揭秘北方用户直连日韩的地理优势与晚高峰专线选型指南。
description.en: A comprehensive comparative analysis of China Unicom AS4837 and AS9929 (A-Net), highlighting Northern China subsea routing advantages to Japan and Korea and peak-hour dedicated line selection.
